recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if FM opens a new substantive issue changing the intended meaning or cardinality of insurance-level claim identifiers.
issue_request: FHIR-55203 was a Resolved - No Change/Not Persuasive FM change request asking whether Claim.insurance.identifier should repeat because identifiers can often be assigned by multiple entities over time.
initial_application: There was no source-changing application because the final WG decision was no-change. The existing Claim.insurance.identifier element came from FHIR-13678 and remained 0..1 in the current Claim StructureDefinition.
additional_context: The element is scoped to an insurance-policy-specific pre-assigned claim number for coordination-of-benefit forwarding, not to all identifiers assigned to the Claim. The Claim request mapping exception records the intentional difference between Request.identifier's repeating cardinality and Claim.insurance.identifier's max 1.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current 0..1 cardinality matches the FM resolution and element purpose.
